headline.text: L1 S3 had *two* metal findings in 15 minutes — X-ray caught screw at MM5, metal detector caught piece in cluster — both Matrix lines, investigation open.

summary: Two active holds: expired ingredient on L1 S3 (Item 10203, 3 pallets) and almond lots J & P on L1 S2 for FM/pest activity. L3 ML1 metal detector belt failed visual inspection after being marked clean.

holds.title: Almond lots J & P held for FM and pest activity
holds.summary: Crew hand-sorting found thread-like FM, insect damage, and suspected pest activity in roasted almond lots; lot P formally held at 00:27 MT, lot J continued sorting until stopped at 05:19 MT.
holds.status: On hold pending disposition — sorting stopped, findings bagged and saved for FSQA review, alternative sourcing plan in progress.

holds.title: Expired ingredient Item 10203 — 3 pallets
holds.summary: Line could not load bed because Item 10203 expired; 3 pallets on hand all same lot, crew searching for usable stock.
holds.status: Resolved — usable material located, line loaded by 08:24 MT.

food_safety.title: Foreign material and pest activity in almond lots
food_safety.summary: Hand-sorting of roasted almonds (lots J and P) revealed thread-like FM, insect damage, holes, and split nuts with suspected pest feeding — crew sorted ~3 hours and found recurring defects.
food_safety.status: On hold pending disposition — lots bagged for FSQA review, team exploring optical sorter as alternative screening method.

food_safety.title: Screw found in MM5 reject bin
food_safety.summary: X-ray at Matrix 5 rejected a bag; inspection found a screw inside the product — team investigating source, line paused to locate origin.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance investigating source as of 10:48 MT.

food_safety.title: Metal piece in cluster rejected by metal detector
food_safety.summary: Metal detector rejected cluster piece; crew inspected reject box, found metal inside product — second metal event on S3 in 15 minutes.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance investigating source as of 11:04 MT.

quality.title: Black spots on caramel pieces
quality.summary: Crew observed black specks on caramel surface; 3 EEs assigned to sort out affected pieces; decision made to run out kettles and caustic-clean rather than risk contamination.
quality.status: Resolved — kettles ran out by 21:00 MT, caustic clean completed.

quality.title: Spec mismatch — pouch vs. internal spec
quality.summary: Pouch label called for 458 g and 26 pieces; internal spec called for 448 g min and 24 pieces — after consultation, team followed pouch guidelines.
quality.status: Resolved — spec update requested to align with pouch, no product at risk.

quality.title: Temper unit faulting on pressure repeatedly
quality.summary: ML2 temper unit faulted 3 times (1st, 2nd, 3rd shifts) due to scraper pressure climbing above setpoint; reheats, fuse replacement, and adjustments required to restart.
quality.status: Open — tempering but recurring fault suggests equipment or recipe issue; summary posted for engineering review.

quality.title: Best By date not centered on wrapper
quality.summary: QA flagged that expiration date was printing off-center; operator adjusted immediately.
quality.status: Resolved — corrected before end of shift.

sanitation.title: Metal detector belt marked clean but failed visual
sanitation.summary: Changeover checklist marked ML1 metal detector belt as cleaned and complete, but visual inspection during startup found it failed — required re-clean before ATP.
sanitation.status: Resolved — belt re-cleaned, ATP passed at 03:14 MT.

opportunities.text: Consider reviewing Matrix metal detection sequence at S3 — today's screw was caught by X-ray but not the upstream metal detector, raising the question whether detector sensitivity or positioning needs adjustment.
Evaluate optical sorter trial for incoming almonds — based on today's FM/pest findings in lots J and P, an automated pre-screen could catch defects before hand-sorting or line use.

Add metal detector belt to post-cleaning visual verification checklist — today's ML1 belt was marked complete but failed visual inspection, suggesting the signoff step needs a defined inspection standard.
